visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of a completed dish: golden-brown fried fish nuggets coated in crispy oats, garnished with bright red chili slices and fresh green basil leaves in a ceramic bowl. The lighting is bright and directional, emphasizing the texture of the crispy coating. (2) A person wearing white latex gloves slices a raw sea bass fillet into bite-sized pieces on a clean surface. (3) The gloved hands place the fish pieces into a glass bowl and add liquid and powder seasonings, mixing them thoroughly by hand. (4) The seasoned fish pieces are pressed into a shallow dish containing white flour/starch until fully coated. (5) A black non-stick frying pan is shown with shimmering hot oil; the gloved hand carefully places the fish pieces into the pan. (6) The fish pieces are filmed in a close-up as they sizzle and turn a deep golden-brown in the bubbling oil. (7) The fried fish is transferred into a dark ceramic bowl using a blue spatula. (8) Minced garlic is added to the remaining oil in the pan and stirred with the spatula until it foams. (9) A bowl containing various dry ingredients including whole oats, breadcrumbs, and yellow curry powder is shown before being added to the pan. (10) A knob of yellow butter is added to the sautéing garlic, followed by the dry oat mixture. (11) The fried fish pieces are returned to the pan, and the chef tosses the pan to coat the fish with the crispy oat mixture. (12) Sliced red chilies and fresh basil are added for the final toss. (13) The video concludes with the finished dish presented in the bowl, identical to the opening shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic, high-tempo pop music begins instantly with a prominent synth bassline. A cheerful male voice introduces the recipe with high arousal. (2) Sound of wet mixing and a soft metallic click as the fish hits the pan. The vocal remains fast-paced and instructional. (3) Crisp, broadband sizzling sounds of deep frying dominate the mid-high frequencies, ducked slightly under the clear narration. (4) Mechanical clinking of a metal spatula against the pan edge. The music maintains a consistent, driving 4/4 beat. (5) Dry, percussive rustling as dry ingredients are poured into a bowl, accompanied by a quick vocal inflection from the narrator. (6) A sharp sizzle as the butter melts, followed by the sound of tossing the pan which creates a rhythmic scraping sound. (7) Final enthusiastic vocal sign-off with the music swelling in volume before a hard cut to silence.
